evidence_basis: 2026-10-27 current Linux process executables, mapped installed library identity and critical-path disassembly; motor firmware and full deployment attestation remain unverified

host.rate_cap_basis: current application transport policy, not a vendor motor limit
host.multi_axis_submission: serial changed-axis commands with individual receipt waits
host.ack_observation: CLI receipt observed by host; not joint arrival or motor application

archived_onboard.feedback_query: sequential per-axis reads after sleep; no per-axis acquisition timestamp
archived_onboard.ack: communication node publishes to joint topic then returns recv acknowledgement
archived_onboard.delay_ms: input to onboard duration calculation; not a host update period or guaranteed arrival time
archived_onboard.all_joint_command: loops over individual joint messages; physical synchronization not established
archived_onboard.power_enable: software bookkeeping: power command sets power_status=1 without hardware switching; receipt of one position command sets enable_status=1 before forwarding
archived_onboard.target_submission: setRawAngle updates local target and writes an angle/interval packet without waiting for arrival; motor firmware adoption remains unknown
archived_onboard.feedback_validity: current library accepts checksum-error angle responses; queryRawAngle ignores receive status and servo ID and may return cached angle after timeout
archived_onboard.transaction_integrity: shared protocol has no complete query/send transaction lock; byte-level serial write lock does not prevent packet construction or byte interleaving races

unknown: motor firmware version and internal feedback/servo frequencies
whether a new position target replaces, queues, or restarts active motor interpolation
maximum sustainable command and valid-feedback rates
physical origin of persistent static residuals after feedback integrity is restored

new_policy.name: shared_progress_v1
new_policy.feedback_timestamp_basis: host receive/accept time; acquisition latency unresolved
new_policy.phase_change_budget: source acceleration times phase-rate squared plus source velocity times phase acceleration
new_policy.no_progress_policy: bounded failure; no target offset, integral correction, or tolerance widening

runtime_identification.scope: Linux processes and installed libraries identified; no code deployed or restarted during this audit

timed_group_policy.name: timed_group_v1
timed_group_policy.clock: board steady_clock; epoch fixed on first accepted chunk
timed_group_policy.input: complete approved six-axis references with original relative arrival times; J6 snapshot preserved
timed_group_policy.buffer: all chunks must arrive before the board epoch; no execution-time append
timed_group_policy.normal_dispatch: write each segment endpoint at the preceding point time, with the segment duration
timed_group_policy.query_scheduling: single UART owner; bounded per-axis query placed before next common group deadline
timed_group_policy.delay_policy: timed segments use their own interval directly; no legacy duration transform
timed_group_policy.late_policy: explicit fault; no silent time shift, backlog catch-up or legacy fallback
timed_group_policy.unchanged_encoded_target: skip repeated 0.1-degree targets rather than restart inactive interpolation
timed_group_policy.tracking: whole-arm 3-degree fault envelope; pause/resume shares one clock at segment boundaries
timed_group_policy.endpoint: three new valid frames within 1 degree with range <=0.3 degree; no retries
timed_group_policy.limits: Linux scheduling and serial writes are not a hard real-time or motor application guarantee
